name: Kasai Momo
source:
Momo is the new health room teacher at the academy, starting this year. Doubling as the first aid room for Dream Garden, the health room benefits from her expertise as a qualified nurse, making her an invaluable member of the park's medical team. With an aura of kindness and a responsible, nurturing demeanor, she embodies the traits of a proper adult. Yet, she often finds it hard to assert herself, habitually taking on tasks that need doing, even when they fall outside her responsibilities.

Special Skill: Baton Twirling
Hobby: Collecting character merchandise
Likes: Fruit-flavored Beer
Dislikes: Getting injections (though she's adept at administering them)
Academic Ability: Exceptionally brilliant
Athletic Ability: Average
Housework: Not her forte
Weakness/Dislike: Struggles with keeping secrets
